beats.say: Corner a cassowary, and it kicks at you with a four inch dagger claw.
And it runs up to fifty kilometers an hour. About thirty miles an hour.
The southern cassowary. One of the heaviest birds on Earth.
Most attacks on people happen after cassowaries have been fed.
It lives in the rainforests of north Queensland, and New Guinea.
Would Meatball survive? Yes. If he keeps his sandwich to himself.
The dad sits on the bright green eggs for about fifty days.
Then he raises the striped chicks for about nine months.
It spreads the seeds of many rainforest plants.
That helmet on its head is called a casque.
Birds are living dinosaurs. This one really looks the part.
That inner claw can be up to four inches long.
The dad does all the babysitting, eggs and chicks.
Scientists say birds are living dinosaurs, the theropod kind.
So leave it alone, and never, ever feed it.
